checks.name: baseline_missing_compatibility_click_reproduction
checks.evidence: Immutable base actual application over HTTP: suppressing only first touch compatibility click leaves dialog/data unchanged; second tap deletes. This is a controlled event-loss reproduction, not a claim of native Chromium failure.

checks.name: n111_mobile_delete_confirmation_first_tap_exactly_once
checks.evidence: 390x844 touch context, real account UI/store/owner guard and source CSS: one tap executes exactly one guarded commit despite suppressed compatibility click. While receipt held, duplicate clicks ignored, dialog retained, no Product rows changed. ACK tombstones only selected class/item/score; other grades, students, history and outbox unchanged. Back/cancel, touchcancel and drag remain read-only.

checks.name: owner_rejection_no_mutation
checks.evidence: Actual account confirm with foreign current Auth identity rejects before commit; all stores unchanged; confirmation remains retryable and no success claimed.

checks.name: failure_and_keyboard_retry
checks.evidence: A native mobile tap with unavailable receipt leaves all Product stores unchanged, keeps durable intent, warns and re-enables confirm without duplicate commit. Enter retries the same mutationId and closes only after valid ACK.

checks.name: owned_resource_cleanup
checks.evidence: Canonical isolated helper closed fresh owned contexts/browser; task-owned ephemeral loopback server closed in finally. No shared/live browser lease required by synthetic exception.
